note: RDR2 mechanics reported to return in GTA VI. Each entry has an economic_impact field describing the GTA VI economy model implications. Source: community leak reports, GTAForums, Reddit r/GTA6.

mechanics.name: Greet and Antagonize (Contextual NPC Dialogue)
mechanics.rdr2_description: Hold/tap button near NPCs to greet (builds honour) or antagonize (loses honour). Unlocks dynamic conversation branches without entering combat.
mechanics.economic_impact: MODERATE — If tied to a reputation system, repeated greeting/antagonizing affects NPC pricing and mission availability. Reputation = new economic variable.
mechanics.wiki_summary: The Honor system in Red Dead Redemption 2 measures Arthur Morgan's moral standing, ranging from Dishonorable (−8) to Honorable (+8). Honour affects NPC dialogue, shop prices (±25%), mission availability, and the game's ending. Greet/antagonize interactions are the primary real-time honour adjustment mechanic.

mechanics.name: Limited Weapon Carry + Vehicle Storage
mechanics.rdr2_description: Arthur can carry 2 long guns + 4 sidearms. Heavier weapons must be stored on horse. Accessing horse retrieves stored weapons.
mechanics.economic_impact: HIGH — Creates a new C (Consumption) category: weapon storage upgrades for vehicles. Limits active loadout, increases tactical spending per mission. Affects net GTA$/hr calculation.
mechanics.wiki_summary: RDR2 limits Arthur to carrying 2 long guns (rifles/shotguns) and 4 handguns simultaneously. Additional weapons are stored on the horse and accessed from the horse's side. This creates a supply/demand tension for tactical loadout decisions that GTA VI is reportedly inheriting.

mechanics.name: Advanced Manual Looting
mechanics.rdr2_description: Players manually open drawers, search pockets, check glove boxes. Each action is animated and takes real time. No instant-loot button.
mechanics.economic_impact: MODERATE — Increases time-cost per loot interaction. Higher payout-per-loot needed to compensate. Affects ambient income floor and mission preparation speed.
mechanics.wiki_summary: Manual looting in RDR2 requires the player to hold a button and watch an animation to search bodies, open drawers, and check containers. Each loot action takes 2–5 real seconds. There is no instant-loot mechanic. This time-cost is a key design signal for GTA VI's expected loot system.

mechanics.name: Dynamic Witness-Based Wanted System (6-star return)
mechanics.rdr2_description: NPCs witness crimes and actively flee to report. Law arrives based on witness reports, not instant detection. Bounty system persists across sessions.
mechanics.source: Multiple community sources + trailer analysis (witness NPC visible in T2)
mechanics.economic_impact: HIGH — 6th star = military response = mission risk ceiling increases. Affects heist insurance modelling and payout premiums for dangerous missions. Bounty system = new ongoing C cost.
mechanics.wiki_summary: RDR2's wanted system is witness-driven rather than detection-based. NPCs who witness a crime flee and alert law enforcement. Law arrives only after a witness reports. Wearing a mask prevents identification (bounty accrual) if no witness survives. Six wanted stars reintroduce military-grade army response.

star_thresholds.note: Rumoured GTA VI return; T2 trailer hint

mechanics.mask_mechanic: Wearing mask prevents bounty accumulation if no witness survives
mechanics.bounty_persistence: Cross-session; cleared at sheriff's office (fee) or post office

mechanics.name: Lucia/Jason Relationship + Honour Meter
mechanics.rdr2_description: RDR2 honour meter (−8 to +8) unlocked different endings, dialogue, and discounts. GTA VI may track a relationship meter between Lucia and Jason.
mechanics.economic_impact: MODERATE — Relationship meter may affect co-op mission payout splits, safe house cost sharing, and unlock thresholds for high-value co-op heists.

mechanics.name: Wildlife and Hunting System
mechanics.rdr2_description: Full ecosystem with 200+ animal species. Hunting requires tracking, correct weapon choice, and precise shooting for perfect pelts. Pelts sold to Trapper/Butcher for income.
mechanics.source: Community reports + Grassrivers region trailer evidence
mechanics.economic_impact: HIGH — New Y (Income) stream: ambient passive income from Grassrivers/rural regions. Low GTA$/hr but zero setup cost. Strong regional economy signal for Leonida vs Vice City income divergence.
mechanics.wiki_summary: Hunting in RDR2 requires tracking animals using Eagle Eye, studying them, and using the correct weapon/ammo to achieve a perfect pelt. Disturbing an animal (wrong ammo, wrong approach) degrades pelt quality. Perfect pelts unlock exclusive Trapper clothing. The system is the most sophisticated hunting mechanic in any GTA-adjacent title.
mechanics.trapper_unlock: Unique clothing sets (not available at standard shops)

mechanics.name: Detective / Threat Detection Mechanic
mechanics.rdr2_description: Eagle Eye highlights tracks, items, and threats. Reduces minimap dependency for environmental awareness.
mechanics.economic_impact: LOW — Primarily gameplay. May affect mission prep efficiency (faster loot identification = slightly higher ambient income rate).
